questions.question: Food 15, games 11, crafts 8 and books 6. Order the stalls from smallest to largest and give the mode.
questions.expected_answer: From smallest to largest: books 6, crafts 8, games 11, food 15. The mode is food, because it was chosen most often.

questions.question: Change 1 and 1/2 km to metres, and find how many 50 cm rosettes can be cut from 4 m of ribbon.
questions.expected_answer: 1 and 1/2 km is 1 000 m plus 500 m, which is 1 500 m. 4 m is 400 cm, and 400 divided by 50 is 8 rosettes.

questions.question: A tablecloth design on grid paper is 6 squares by 4 squares. Find its area and its perimeter.
questions.expected_answer: The area is 4 rows of 6 squares, which is 24 square units. The perimeter is 6 plus 4 plus 6 plus 4, which is 20 units.
